text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That was a great workout! Thanks
oodl—thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gett'n better,
aren't I? My time's a lot
shorter now, and I'm gett'n
used to the
city's ways now too.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm slowly but surely mak'n my way
towards being a real city girl!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(But in the beginn'n, gee whiz was I a
doofus... If it weren't for my
trainer, I
woulda been in a real pickle.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, next up is haul'n tires! Thanks
again for check'n on me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe I thought add'n weights
while runn'n uphill would
make me
stronger. I'm lucky I didn't hurt m'self.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You look like a busy bee right now, but be
sure to give 'em a taste
late—hm? What
are these notes? Why's my name written
on 'em?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Even after witness'n my foolishness
firsthand, they still went to the
trouble of
creat'n a train'n regimen for me... If it
wasn't for them...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Geez Louise, my trainer's done noth'n but
take care of me...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I know I gave 'em rice crackers... but
Trainer deserve more'n that!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: So that's what's on your mind, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I wanna show my trainer I've gotten
closer t'being the city girl
of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that should prove how much I've
grown, right? I'm sure see'n
my progress
would make my trainer real chipper.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, Yukino, I didn't realize you like your trainer that much! It's honestly kinda cute. In that case, why don't you...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! N-no! Nothin's wrong! I'm perf'ctly
peachy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has been acting strange all
day. It seems like she has
something to
say, but she's holding back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could it be related to her training?
Perhaps she's not happy with the
current
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-nope, not me! Not a lick...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: S-someth'n on my mind?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (There is... There is, but... but...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say't! How could I poss'bly...
Ohhh,
my heart's going bananas!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her face goes bright red, but instead of
saying something, she begins
to pace
around the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever she's worried about, it must be
pretty bad. Perhaps it would
be best not
to pry further, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (You've already done so much for me, and now you wanna help more?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I can't let that happen! No matter how
embarrass'n, I gotta get a hold
of m'self
and... and...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Ask them out on a date!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Urk! N-never mind! I'll tell you later!
Just
you wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she rushes off, leaving me
confused and concerned
with what could
be eating at her.
